validator.source_text:
<?ui-args --policy lax?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:ed="urn:example:editor" version="1.0" initial="a" xml:lang="en">
  <ed:layout width="640" height="480"/>
  <state id="a" ed:x="10" ed:y="20">
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: this compiler cannot lower attribute `xml:lang` from another namespace on `<scxml>`
notes: this is a limit of this toolchain, not an SCXML rule: SCXML 1.0 allows attributes from other namespaces on its elements (the W3C schema's `##other` wildcards), but the compiler lowers only SCXML attributes on SCXML elements and rejects any other attribute rather than drop it silently; only custom actions (elements in another namespace) keep their attributes
diagnostics.help: to compile the document with this toolchain, remove the attribute: `xml:*` and `xsi:*` attributes carry no SCXML behavior

diagnostics.message: this compiler cannot lower `<ed:layout>` from namespace `urn:example:editor` inside `<scxml>`

secondary.message: this compiler lowers only SCXML children of `<scxml>`

notes: this is a limit of this toolchain, not an SCXML rule: SCXML 1.0 allows elements from other namespaces in its content models (the W3C schema's `##other` wildcards), but the compiler lowers them only as executable content (custom actions in `<onentry>`, `<onexit>`, `<transition>`, `<finalize>`, `<if>`, or `<foreach>`) and rejects them anywhere else rather than drop them silently
diagnostics.help: to compile the document with this toolchain, move the element into executable content, or remove it
